entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To speak with an agent, please press 1.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, this is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I need to return an item. It's the VeloBand Pulse. It's just not what I expected.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-789012.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered 10 days ago, on the 14th. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. So, how do I start the return?

I understand you'd like to return it. I do need to inform you that the VeloBand Pulse has a specific return policy. Due to its nature as a wearable electronic device, it has a strict 10-day return window.
What? Ten days? It's been exactly ten days. I'm calling on the tenth day.
I see that, but unfortunately, the system shows that the 10-day window concluded at the end of yesterday. Since we're now on day 11, the item is no longer eligible for a return.
That is completely unacceptable! A 10-day window is ridiculous to begin with, and now you're telling me I missed it by a few hours? No. I want to return it.
I do apologize for the frustration, but that policy is highlighted on the product page and in the order confirmation. I'm not able to override it in my system.
This is absurd. I need to speak to your supervisor right now. This policy makes no sense and I'm not just going to be stuck with a $150 device I don't want.

I understand your position, and I hear your frustration. While my manager would have to tell you the same information regarding the return policy, as it's a hard-coded rule, perhaps I can explore another option with you first.
I don't want another option, I want a refund. If you can't do it, let me speak to your boss. I want to talk to a manager who can actually solve this problem.

I can certainly note your request. Before I do that, please allow me to propose a solution. While I cannot process a refund to your card, I am authorized to offer you the full value of the VeloBand Pulse, which is $149.99, as store credit. And for the inconvenience and frustration this policy has caused, I can add an additional $25 credit to your VeloFit account. That would be a total of $174.99 you could use on any other gear.
Wait, so... the full price plus an extra $25?

Yes, that's correct. You wouldn't have to ship the Pulse back, and the credit would be available in your account immediately. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear, even if this particular item wasn't the right fit.
...Okay. You know, that's... actually a really good offer. I've been looking at one of your cycling jerseys. That would more than cover it.
I'm so glad to hear that. I think that's a great solution. Would you like me to go ahead and process that $174.99 store credit for you?
Yes, please. That would be great. I'm sorry I got so heated, it was just... frustrating.
Not a problem at all, I completely understand. I've just applied the credit to your account. You should see it reflected if you log in. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you, Alex. You really turned this around for me. I appreciate it.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
